div.div:
OPTION 1: OAuth2 client-credentials
ISV Platform gets a Bearer JWT from Provider Entra ID (client_credentials grant), presents it to APIM. validate-jwt checks issuer/audience/claims.

text.tspan: ISV Platform gets a Bearer JWT from Provider Entra ID
(client_credentials grant), presents it to APIM. validate-jwt

div.div:
OPTION 2: APIM Subscription Key
ISV Platform sends an Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header. APIM validates the key against the client's product/subscription.

text.tspan: ISV Platform sends an Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header. APIM

div.div: Both options terminate identity at the gateway. Only the front-door credential (Option 1 vs Option 2, shown above) differs - everything from APIM onward (managed identity to Foundry, Foundry's internal call to Anthropic) is identical regardless of choice. A client can start on Option 2 for a fast pilot and move to Option 1 later without changing anything past the front door.

text.tspan: Both options terminate identity at the gateway. Only the front-door credential (Option 1 vs Option 2, shown above) differs - everything from APIM onward (managed identity to Foundry, Foundry's internal call to Anthropic) is identical regardless of
choice. A client can start on Option 2 for a fast pilot and move to Option 1 later without changing anything past the front door.
